name: rtl8xxxu
description: Realtek RTL8192EU, RTL8723BU and other 802.11n adapters, with the driver of the kernel
comments: Kernels 4.6 and newer for the RTL8192EU and RTL8723BU, the rtl8xxxu of older kernels has only the RTL8723AU and RTL8192CU: for the RTL8192EU, the rtl8192eu profile. The RTL8188EU and RTL8188FU are in the rtl8xxxu of kernels newer than DSM ones: the rtl8188eus and rtl8188fu profiles.
